exposure: Use of pregnancy mobile app-Circle by Providence
outcome: Nutritional measures (prenatal vitamin intake, fruit and vegetable consumption, caffeine intake)
cohort: Patients receiving prenatal care at one of seven Providence clinics and who had a live birth at a Providence hospital
finding: The use of the Circle app, which provides personalized and evidence-based health information, was associated with an increase in certain healthy behaviors and health knowledge, although there was no impact on clinical health outcomes.
